npc.cast_dialog.brotherkiran: May this blessing protect you, my friend.
npc.cast_dialog.moonrock: May this magic close your wounds, child.
npc.dialog.brotherkiran: Welcome to the temple, friend. Artherk watches over those who walk in the light. If you wish, I can *bless* you in his name.
npc.dialog.darkfang: Only other dragons know my ancient name, for I am the greatest dragon of Firesky. You mortals may call me "Darkfang".
npc.dialog.kilhiam: Welcome, traveler. Healing and light are gifts I can share with those willing to *learn*.
npc.dialog.kalastor: Speed and stealth are my domain. Say *train* if you seek my tutelage.
npc.dialog.mhorgwloth: The body heals swiftly when trained. Say *train* to begin.
npc.dialog.moonrock: Welcome to the temple, child. If you need help coping with these difficult times, you can always take shelter within these walls. I am the Bishop of this church. I can heal your wounds using powerful magic.
npc.dialog.murmuntag: I can teach you the art of combat. Say *train* when you are ready.
npc.dialog.ortanalas: Strength of arm and sharpness of eye — I train both. Say *train*.
npc.dialog.rolph: I own the best armor shop in all of Goldmoon! Say *buy* to browse my wares.
npc.dialog.sigfried: Finest weapons in Lighthaven! Say *buy* to see what I have.
